purpose: Matched MuJoCo feedback validation of the accepted transport solver; no new-paper claim.
policy: Every native moving-grid Hamiltonian decision, encoded losslessly as -1/0/+1. Interpolate physical grid axes at query time, then use the same trilinear reference-cell weights in both time slices and linearly blend their rates. Select a terminal goal from the initial final value and retain it throughout the episode.
selection: Seeded disjoint native-grid states from the no-assistance final value before any rollouts. Inside V<0, outside V>0, boundary among 2000 smallest absolute values. Positive initial velocity; torque/contact admissible and final policy-domain coverage in both modes. Reuse identical initial states in none/GC and both physics steps. GC predictions recorded separately.
success: Reach an original terminal box at 1.4 s with C1/C3-C5 valid throughout, including the final state. Report all predicted-inside successes and failures; never replace an out-of-coverage policy.
matching: OM shares one identical physical ankle target across modes. YF source-entry ankle/toe goals retain each plant's frozen geometry; mode comparisons do not imply identical complete target sets.
video_selection: First preselected case with completed none/GC fine-step trajectories for each population, in inside/boundary/outside order. Record the selected index and both outcomes; no recovery-based selection.
scope: Reduced paper model only. Existing articulated-human videos retain their historical controller provenance. No guarantee transferred to 9 DoF or hardware.
reader_repair: Use reference-cell interpolation on the space-time moving mesh; require coverage at the interpolated physical grid. The failed fixed-physical-point reader required intersection coverage and rejected valid cells.
cohort_origin: Exact same initial states frozen under v1 before any campaign rollouts; all policy files, numerical limits and experiment conditions unchanged.
